source: QxYYYY DomainName QA CoE Audit Checklist.xlsx

criteria.criterion: Is project scope defined and documented?
criteria.evidence_guidance: Verify the test strategy and/or test plan.

criteria.criterion: Was project kick-off conducted?
criteria.evidence_guidance: Look for the project kick-off meeting invitation or meeting minutes and search all folders. If neither is present, mark Fail regardless of a kick-off date recorded in the RFS.

criteria.criterion: Are QA entry and exit criteria identified?
criteria.evidence_guidance: Review the test plan.

criteria.criterion: Are lessons learned identified/documented?
criteria.evidence_guidance: Review lessons-learned documentation.

criteria.criterion: Was project sign-off and/or a test summary created?
criteria.evidence_guidance: Review the project sign-off and test summary artifacts.

criteria.criterion: Is the RFS complete and approved?
criteria.evidence_guidance: Review the RFS and approval. Include holidays and vacation plans shown in QAgile screenshots.

criteria.criterion: Does the SharePoint RBS structure contain the required folders?
criteria.evidence_guidance: Verify cumulative folders through the current phase returned by Project Status Identifier: Test Initiation; then Test Planning; then Test Design; then Test Execution; then Test Closure. Require only Test Initiation at Test Initiation, add each preceding/current phase folder at later phases, and do not require future-phase folders.

criteria.criterion: Are test cases optimized using CTD best practices?
criteria.evidence_guidance: Use IQPP screenshots as evidence.

criteria.criterion: Are requirements uploaded and linked to test cases?
criteria.evidence_guidance: Review screenshots showing uploaded requirements and test-case links.

criteria.criterion: Are CTD and automated test cases uploaded in the test management tool?
criteria.evidence_guidance: Review ALM or Jira screenshots.

criteria.criterion: Are QAgile entries present for CTD and automation jobs and execution?
criteria.evidence_guidance: Review the supplied screenshot evidence.

criteria.criterion: Were negative test scenarios identified and negative testing performed?
criteria.evidence_guidance: The source checklist states a target of 5%. Verify the calculation only when the evidence provides a denominator.

criteria.criterion: Was a regression folder created in ALM or Jira?
criteria.evidence_guidance: Review the ALM or Jira project structure.

criteria.criterion: Was the test-case and QAgile archival process followed?
criteria.evidence_guidance: Review evidence of the archival process.

criteria.criterion: Is defect-closure information complete?
criteria.evidence_guidance: For closed defects, validate Defect Resolution, Defect Type/Reason, and Application Name. Check that UAT and rejected defects have correct data.

criteria.criterion: Does the TRR address risks, assumptions, issues, and defects?
criteria.evidence_guidance: Review the TRR.

criteria.criterion: Was the NFT team engaged?
criteria.evidence_guidance: Evaluate Security, Penetration, and Performance engagement.

criteria.criterion: Is the test case library maintained?
criteria.evidence_guidance: If a Master Test Case Library is visibly present in the evidence, mark Pass; no additional proof of maintenance is required.

criteria.criterion: Has the RFS been reviewed?
criteria.evidence_guidance: Review the RFS in QAgile.

criteria.criterion: Are test scope and test entrance-criteria assumptions defined for each release or sprint?
criteria.evidence_guidance: Review the test plan or a Confluence page covering scope and validations for all sprints. Test plan content may vary based on grooming sessions.

criteria.criterion: Are optimized test cases uploaded to Jira under the relevant project key?
criteria.evidence_guidance: Best practices: use Zephyr to create a test cycle, create a relevant folder based on build/release, and upload or write test cases as needed.

criteria.criterion: Is requirement traceability maintained?
criteria.evidence_guidance: Verify that test cases are linked to user stories.

criteria.criterion: Are negative test scenarios verified?
criteria.evidence_guidance: Review the CTD model.

criteria.criterion: Are regression test cases maintained according to the audit criteria?
criteria.evidence_guidance: Verify a cycle named '<Application Name> Regression'; all regression cases are in that cycle; cases are pulled from it for cycles needing regression execution; and the application name matches the QAgile all-application list.

criteria.criterion: Are old, outdated, or inactive test cases labeled as archived?
criteria.evidence_guidance: Review test-case labels.

criteria.criterion: Are defects linked and closed with appropriate root cause, and are requirement ambiguities identified?
criteria.evidence_guidance: Verify defects link to user stories, failed test cases link to defects, closed defects have an appropriate root cause, and defects resulting from requirement ambiguities are identified.

criteria.criterion: Is the test summary/test sign-off document complete?
criteria.evidence_guidance: Verify the defect summary and any risks, issues, or requirement ambiguities.

criteria.criterion: Was the NFT team engaged, or is an exception status documented?
criteria.evidence_guidance: Evaluate Security, Penetration, and Performance engagement. If not engaged, provide the exception status.

criteria.criterion: Is the test case library maintained according to the audit criteria?
criteria.evidence_guidance: Verify a cycle named 'Master Test Case Library', a folder named for the application, and valid test cases stored under that application.

criteria.criterion: Are test cases automated?
criteria.evidence_guidance: Review automation evidence.

criteria.criterion: Are test cases optimized using CTD best practices?
criteria.evidence_guidance: Use IQPP screenshots as evidence.

criteria.criterion: Are QAgile entries present for CTD and automation jobs and execution?
criteria.evidence_guidance: Review the supplied screenshot evidence.
